info.title: Visual Sentinel Public API
info.description:
Comprehensive website monitoring API with 6-layer monitoring: Uptime, Performance, SSL, DNS, Visual regression detection, and Content change detection.

## Authentication

Every endpoint below accepts two authentication methods interchangeably (unified auth, as of 2.25.0):

### 1. Session Cookie (Web Clients)
Call `POST /api/auth/login` with email + password to get a session cookie. The cookie is automatically sent with subsequent requests. Session writes are CSRF-protected (send `X-CSRF-Token` on POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE).

### 2. Bearer API Key (Agents, Integrations, Mobile Apps, Scripts)
Generate an API key in **Settings > API Keys**. Send it via any of:
- `Authorization: Bearer vs_xxxxx` header (recommended)
- `X-API-Key: vs_xxxxx` header
- `?api_key=vs_xxxxx` query parameter

API keys enforce scopes automatically:
- GET requests require `{resource}:read` scope
- POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE require `{resource}:write` scope
- Wildcard (`*`) grants full access
- Platform-admin endpoints under `/api/admin/*` are blocked for API keys regardless of scope
- CSRF is skipped for Bearer-auth'd requests (mobile-friendly)

Resources: `monitors`, `servers`, `channels`, `alerts`, `incidents`, `status-pages`, `teams`, `organization`, `maintenance`, `analytics`, `billing`, `user`

### Session-only endpoints (cookie required)
The following endpoints stay session-only by design and cannot be called with an API key:
- `/api/auth/*` (login, logout, refresh, 2FA, password reset, OAuth)
- `/api/billing/checkout` (dual-path: authed upgrade OR anonymous signup)
- `/api/integrations/slack/auth` (OAuth init redirect)
- `/api/organization/invitations/accept` (email-link flow)
- `/api/user/delete-account` (destructive, blast-radius guardrail)
- `/api/user/organizations/switch` (mutates session cookie)
- `/api/chat/*`, `/api/ai/*`, `/api/incidents/:id/summarize`, `/api/reports/digest` (AI-powered features, not exposed via API keys due to token costs and abuse potential)

**Note:** API access requires the Business plan or higher.

## Mobile apps (iOS, Android, Mac)

Native apps can use the same login flow: `POST /api/auth/login` returns a JWT. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` on every subsequent request. CSRF is automatically skipped for Bearer tokens. Token refresh is via `POST /api/auth/refresh` with the refresh token in the request body (or `X-Client-Type: mobile` header).

## Rate Limits

- Login: 5 attempts per 15 minutes
- Registration: 3 per hour
- Monitor creation: 20 per hour
- Alert rules: 10 per hour
- Bulk operations: 10 per minute
- Tools (public): 10 per minute per IP
- API key requests: per-key rate limit (default 1000/hour, configurable at key creation)

## Base URL

Production: `https://visualsentinel.com`
